notes: No local measures on Lincoln County's November 3, 2026 general ballot: the Auditor's sample ballot and Local Voters' Pamphlet (https://www.lincolncountywa.com/312/Current-Future-Elections) and VoteWA's online guide for the county (https://voter.votewa.gov/genericvoterguide.aspx?e=899&c=22) list none.
Lincoln County Commissioner District 3 is nominated by district and elected county-wide in the general (RCW 36.32.040, RCW 36.32.050(1)); it is scoped COUNTY.
